fields.description: Sector-extensible capability class (findings F-07): a Select keeps matching deterministic; 'Other' plus the label keeps it extensible without schema churn — options are only ever ADDED (PSIRA grades and construction plant close the same way later)

fields.label: Item
fields.description: What the item IS, e.g. 'www.client-municipality.gov.za', 'Teraco JB1', 'PSIRA registration'

fields.label: Value
fields.description: The claimable value, e.g. '99.9% monthly', 'ZA-only', 'PSIRA Grade B'

fields.label: Detail
fields.description: Supporting detail an evaluator would want, e.g. scope of the reference engagement, data-centre tier, cert scope

fields.label: Reference URL
fields.description: Live URL for portfolio/reference items (evaluators do click these)

fields.label: Valid Until
fields.description: Expiry for certifications/registrations — an expired cert claimed as current is a misrepresentation risk
